    - housing/index.qmd

  sort: "date desc"

```{=html}
<style>
.listing-filter-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}
.listing-filter-row .quarto-listing-filter {
  width: 400px;
  margin-bottom: 0 !important;
}
.quarto-listing-filter .form-control,
.quarto-listing-filter .input-group-text {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
}
#listing-category-select {
  width: auto;
  min-width: 240px;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
}
.quarto-post {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  padding-top: 15px;
}
</style>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var filterDiv = document.querySelector(".quarto-listing-filter");
  if (!filterDiv) return;

  var select = document.createElement("select");
  select.id = "listing-category-select";
  select.className = "form-select form-select-lg";

  [
    ["", "All Categories"],
    ["Population", "Population"],
    ["Housing", "Housing"],
    ["Land Use", "Land Use"]
  ].forEach(function (pair) {
    var opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = pair[0];
    opt.textContent = pair[1];
    select.appendChild(opt);
  });

  select.addEventListener("change", function () {
    var val = this.value;
    window.quartoListingCategory(
      val === "" ? "" : btoa(encodeURIComponent(val))
    );
  });

  var row = document.createElement("div");
  row.className = "listing-filter-row";
  filterDiv.parentNode.insertBefore(row, filterDiv);
  row.appendChild(filterDiv);
  row.appendChild(select);
});
</script>
```
